body:
## Summary
- Control points now match blueprint.html style: transparent fill (`rgba(0,0,0,0)`), dashed stroke (`stroke-dasharray: 4 2`), `stroke-width: 2` — no filled circles
- Start point: green dashed stroke, Center: link color dashed stroke, End: red dashed stroke
- All three control points (start, center, end) per link are draggable with snap-to-grid (half-grid snap like blueprint.html)
- Dragging center moves the entire link (start + center + end together)
- IK is recomputed on each drag, only the affected link's path is updated (not full re-render)
- Per-link positions (start, center, end) persist to localStorage and restore on page load
- Pan is suppressed while dragging a control point to prevent conflicts
- Intermediate points (p1–p6) are not rendered as they are not interactive

## Test plan
- [x] All existing unit tests pass (48/48)
- [ ] Open `grid.html` in browser and verify:
  - Control points look like blueprint.html (dashed circles, no fill)
  - Start/center/end are all draggable per link
  - Points snap to half-grid intersections
  - Dragging center moves entire link
  - Links can be snapped to each other
  - Positions persist across page reload
  - Reset button restores default layout
  - Zoom/pan still works, does not conflict with drag
  - Touch drag works on mobile

Fixes #23
